Manifest.Name: Eleanor Story Expand / 上层区的富家千金爱上在下层区开当铺的我：埃莉诺剧情扩展
Manifest.Author: EleanorRomance Team
Manifest.Description: 1.39 rewrites the current dialogue and narration across the romance, harem, attendant and revolution routes, adds post-ending daily window visits for the romance, attendant and revolution routes, and updates event/ending CGs and portraits with consistent earrings. Simplified Chinese and English are regenerated; Japanese and Korean are aligned with the Chinese key set. Legacy harem scenes and retired UI text are cleaned up. The 1.38 portrait compatibility, two-person speaker fix and earlier fixes remain. 1.39 重写恋爱、后宫、侍从、革命军四条路线当前启用的对白与旁白；新增恋爱、侍从、革命军结局后的日常窗口事件；更新事件/结局 CG 与立绘，统一埃莉诺耳饰；简中/英文同步，日文/韩文与简中键集对齐；清理旧版后宫与退役 UI 文本；保留 1.38 立绘兼容、双角色首句名字修复及更早修复。简体中文 / English / 日语 / 韩语 (ZH / EN / JA / KO)。
